member.name: M:Blobject.Core.BlobClientBase.DeleteAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Deletes an object from the BLOB storage asynchronously. For objects contained within subdirectories or folders, use the / character. For example, path/to/folder/myfile.txt For file storage platforms, when deleting a folder, use / at the end of the key.
member.param: The key of the object to delete from the BLOB storage.
member.returns: A task representing the asynchronous operation.

member.name: M:Blobject.Core.BlobClientBase.DeleteManyAsync(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{System.String},System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Deletes multiple objects from the BLOB storage asynchronously. For objects contained within subdirectories or folders, use the / character. For example, path/to/folder/myfile.txt For file storage platforms, when deleting a folder, use / at the end of the key. Providers with a native bulk-delete API override this method to use it; otherwise deletions are fanned out over using . Deleting a key that does not exist is treated as a successful deletion.
member.param: The keys of the objects to delete from the BLOB storage. Null or empty keys are ignored.
member.returns: A describing the outcome for each key.

member.returns: A task representing the asynchronous operation. The task result is true if the object exists; otherwise, false.
